name: com.cidonix.unibridge
description: Local MCP tools that let AI coding agents inspect, edit, capture, and validate Unity Editor projects through a per-project bridge and relay.

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed

- Serialized array and List property writes now verify collection size and every nested field instead of comparing the requested count with the structured array readback envelope.
- Nested Unity object references use stable GlobalObjectId, GUID/local file ID, or scene/indexed hierarchy identity before transient object IDs.
- Collection readback reports expected and actual sizes plus verified and failed descendant counts; genuine mismatches still fail and trigger transactional rollback.

### Previous Changes

- A dependency-free Unity 2017.4 compatibility adapter is available under Legacy~/Unity2017.
- BatchActions hierarchy references are no longer misclassified as filesystem paths.
- RuntimeStateProbe sampling remains active when Time.timeScale is zero and releases its scheduler slot reliably.
